claims.quote: Betta mandor occurs in the forested blackwater peat-swamps of West Kalimantan, Borneo (Indonesia).
At time of writing it has only been collected close to the villages of Mandor and Anjungan in the lower Kapuas River basin, West Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat), Borneo, Indonesia.
